tools.name: query_compliance_tracker
tools.description: Read the NDA compliance tracker to see each new hire's current NDA status and last-updated date.

tools.name: retrieve_onboarding_roster
tools.description: Read the onboarding roster to obtain each new hire's legal name, role, work email, and start date.

tools.name: retrieve_signed_documents_archive
tools.description: Read the DocuSign completed-envelopes archive to confirm which new hires already have a valid signed NDA on file.

tools.name: check_nda_template_library
tools.description: Read the NDA template library to identify the current approved NDA template and its DocuSign template ID.

tools.name: reconcile_nda_status
tools.description: Cross-check the tracker, roster, and signed-documents archive to determine which new hires genuinely still need an NDA, correcting for voided or mistemplated envelopes.

tools.name: draft_nda_sendout_batch
tools.description: Compile a draft NDA send-out batch (recipient name, email, template, and proposed envelope) for the manager to review and approve before anything is sent.

tools.name: send_nda_envelope_via_docusign
tools.description: Send NDA envelopes to new hires via DocuSign for signature.

tools.name: update_tracker_nda_status
tools.description: Update the NDA status column in the compliance tracker to reflect sent or signed envelopes.

tools.name: void_existing_nda_envelope
tools.description: Void an existing DocuSign NDA envelope (e.g., a mistemplated or duplicate envelope) in the DocuSign account.

tools.name: read_hr_policy_manual
tools.description: Read the HR policy manual for NDA timing, approval, and template rules.

tools.name: lookup_team_directory
tools.description: Look up HR team members and the designated NDA batch approver.
